title.en: International business: meaning, reasons and how it differs from domestic business
title.kn: ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ: ಅರ್ಥ, ಕಾರಣಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ದೇಶೀಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದಿಂದ ಭಿನ್ನತೆ

heading.en: Coffee from Chikkamagaluru, phones from abroad

hook.en: Coffee grown in Chikkamagaluru is drunk in Italy, while the phone in your pocket may have parts from five countries. Why do nations trade with each other?
hook.kn: ಚಿಕ್ಕಮಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಕಾಫಿಯನ್ನು ಇಟಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಡಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೇಬಿನ ಫೋನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಐದು ದೇಶಗಳ ಭಾಗಗಳಿರಬಹುದು. ದೇಶಗಳು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಏಕೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ?

objectives.en: Distinguish international business from domestic business

narration.en: Coffee grown in Chikkamagaluru is drunk in Italy, while the phone in your pocket may have parts from five countries. Why do nations trade with each other?
narration.kn: ಚಿಕ್ಕಮಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಕಾಫಿಯನ್ನು ಇಟಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಡಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೇಬಿನ ಫೋನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಐದು ದೇಶಗಳ ಭಾಗಗಳಿರಬಹುದು. ದೇಶಗಳು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಏಕೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ?

body.en: International business refers to manufacturing and trade activities that cross national frontiers. It is wider than international trade: besides exports and imports of goods and services, it includes licensing and franchising, contract manufacturing and foreign investment. Nations trade because natural resources are unequally distributed, labour productivity and production costs differ due to differences in factors such as skills, technology and climate, and so each nation gains by specialising in what it can produce at a comparatively lower cost and trading for the rest.
body.kn: ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಗಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಟುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾ ವೆಚ್ಚ ದೇಶದಿಂದ ದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಭಿನ್ನವಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ದೇಶಗಳು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Wider than trade: includes services, licensing, investment
Basis: unequal resources and different costs

narration.en: International business crosses national borders. Nations trade because resources and production costs differ from country to country.
narration.kn: ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಗಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಟುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾ ವೆಚ್ಚ ದೇಶದಿಂದ ದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಭಿನ್ನವಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ದೇಶಗಳು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: International business is wider than international trade. Trade is only one part of it.

say.en: International business is wider than international trade. Trade is only one part of it.
Why trade? Resources and costs differ. If India makes textiles cheaper and Japan makes electronics cheaper, both gain by specialising and trading.
How does it differ from domestic business?
Customers vary across markets, each country has its own rules and tariffs, and more than one currency is used, so risk is higher.

narration.en: Sort each feature: domestic business or international business.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಲಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ದೇಶೀಯ ಅಥವಾ ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಎಂದು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

prompt.en: Sort each feature: domestic business or international business.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಲಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ದೇಶೀಯ ಅಥವಾ ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಎಂದು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

explanation.en: International business deals with different nationalities, currencies, laws, political systems and customer tastes, so it is more complex and riskier.

text.en: Buyer and seller from the same country
One set of laws and policies
Payment in more than one currency, with exchange-rate risk
Customers in many markets with very different tastes
Risk of a change in a foreign government's policy
Factors of production move much less freely

body.en: International business differs from domestic business in: nationality of buyers and sellers (different countries), nationality of other stakeholders such as employees and investors, mobility of factors of production (much less mobile between countries), customer heterogeneity across markets, differences in business systems and practices, political systems and risks, business regulations and policies such as tariffs and quotas, and the currency used (more than one currency, with exchange rate risk). As a result, international business is more complex and riskier.
body.kn: ದೇಶೀಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿದರೆ ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರವು ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯತೆ, ಕರೆನ್ಸಿ, ಕಾನೂನು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾಯಕರ.

points.en: Different nationalities of buyers and sellers
Less mobility of factors of production

narration.en: Compared with domestic business, international business deals with different nationalities, currencies, laws and customs, so it is more complex and risky.
narration.kn: ದೇಶೀಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿದರೆ ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರವು ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯತೆ, ಕರೆನ್ಸಿ, ಕಾನೂನು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾಯಕರ.

tryThis.en: Let the rupee strengthen from ₹83 to ₹81. How much does the exporter lose on $10,000?
Now let the rupee weaken to ₹86. Who gains?
Why does domestic business not face this risk?

problem.en: A Mangaluru cashew exporter signs a contract to sell to a US buyer for $50,000 when the exchange rate is ₹83 per dollar. When payment arrives, the rate is ₹81 per dollar. Find the rupee amount at both rates and the effect on the exporter.

steps.en: Domestic sales carry no such currency risk: this shows why international business is riskier.

answer.en: The exporter receives ₹1,00,000 less because of the change in exchange rate.
